newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian gas blast kills two, injures 25.
newsitem.headline: Belgian gas blast kills two, injures 25.

text.p: A gas explosion destroyed a bank in the eastern Belgian town of Theux on Saturday, killing two firemen and injuring at least 25 other people.
The blast blew off the corner of a building in the town centre which housed a branch of Banque Bruxelles Lambert. The bank had been closed for the weekend and was empty.
"There is damage in a 70-metre (yard) radius," a spokesman from the fire station in the nearby town of Verviers told Reuters. The injuries were mainly caused by flying glass.

Doctors working at a temporary medical post at the scene told Belgian television at least 25 people had been injured, and there were reports that two were in a serious condition after being trapped in a car when the explosion occurred.
Inital fire brigade estimates had put the number of people hurt at 10.
